evidence.title: GeoRisk-RAG: A Hierarchy-Aware Risk Framework for Improving RAG Reliability through Selective Answering

summary: A new study proposes GeoRisk-RAG, a framework that improves the reliability of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems by selectively answering questions based on hierarchical risk assessment. The method aims to reduce errors in AI-generated responses by prioritizing high-confidence information.
title: Researchers Introduce GeoRisk-RAG: A Hierarchy-Aware Framework to Enhance RAG Reliability
